entries.speaker: Bar Promoter
entries.en: Welcome to our izakaya! How 'bout[n]some all-you-can-drink booze on the[n]cheap?

entries.en: Wait... You underage?
Nope.
Is that a problem?

entries.speaker: Bar Promoter
entries.en: Oh? In that case come in for[n]an hour or two!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How did you get caught up in this!?[n]Come on, ignore him!

entries.speaker: Bar Promoter
entries.en: Heh, so you're just a kid. Get outta here.[n]You're in the way.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Tch... You're the one who was all[n]wantin' to talk to us.

entries.speaker: Suspicious Salesman
entries.en: Hey, man... You wanna come play?

entries.speaker: Suspicious Salesman
entries.en: Touch all you want, no added fees.[n]We have the cutest girls in town too.
I'm not interested.
Tell me more.

entries.speaker: Suspicious Salesman
entries.en: C'mon, I'll make it cheap. Whaddya say?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Did you really just ask that?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just ignore that guy, you idiot.[n]No matter what way you cut it,[n]he's a shady character.

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: You have a moment?

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: Are you a student? You shouldn't[n]be out this late.
I'm a high schooler.
I'm a college student.
I'm an adult.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, wait!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We, uh, graduated a loooong time ago.[n]We're adults, y'know!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, yeah. We're adults, y'see.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yup. People mistake us all the time for[n]younger kids, though.

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: Hm? Are you a friend of his?

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: Wait a second... I've seen the pattern on[n]those pants before.

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: Maybe on the news... Oh yeah, it was[n]on that segment about the teacher who[n]was harassing kids!

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: Is that a school uniform...!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Shit.

entries.speaker: Patrolling Officer
entries.en: You kids have got to be high schoolers![n]Come with me!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Shoot! This is why I said uniforms were[n]a bad idea!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's run!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...How much longer until we get there?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, it ain't our fault we had to deal with[n]that detour! Our school's gettin' real[n]famous!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, didn't we just pass by that[n]Crossroads place?

entries.speaker: Fortune Teller
entries.en: E-Excuse me!

entries.speaker: Fortune Teller
entries.en: For the blond one, I can sense[n]impending woman troubles. Or...[n]perhaps it's something else?

entries.speaker: Fortune Teller
entries.en: In any case, horrible disaster is coming[n]for you! Please let me examine your[n]future further!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What!? Me?

entries.speaker: Fortune Teller
entries.en: Yes, I suggest you get your fortune told![n]What I say will surely come to pass!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: More of this shit...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry, but we're in a hurry. An' I don't[n]really believe in that stuff anyways.

entries.speaker: Fortune Teller
entries.en: I see. My apologies.

entries.speaker: Fortune Teller
entries.en: However... if you change your mind,[n]I'll be waiting [clr 2]here in this spot at night[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Fortune Teller
entries.en: May your fortunes be well...
